selection_policy: Maximum 5; only promote on full-universe unseen evidence, costs, liquidity and independent walk-forward; never call sure-shot

setups.name: Confirmed ATH breakout and retest
setups.note: 5+ closes above prior ATH, >=5% advance, retest within 2% while holding ATH and 50-period average; audit historical causality

setups.name: VCP breakout with volume
setups.note: Chartink reference additionally uses SMA50>SMA150>SMA200, close cross above prior 20-high, volume >1.5x 50-volume SMA and daily/weekly/monthly RSI; not identical to ScanStock VCP and not yet implemented as an exact copy

setups.name: EMA21 trend pullback bounce
setups.note: 21EMA>50SMA>200SMA; low tags 21EMA within 1%; bullish close above previous high; RSI14 45..65; volume >20-day average. Exact individual scanner rule page not independently verified.

setups.name: 20-day closing breakout with volume
setups.note: Close > maximum of previous 20 daily closes; volume > previous-day 20-volume SMA. Distinct from existing ScanStock previous-high20 breakout.

setups.name: Bullish RSI divergence
setups.note: Current daily low < low two weeks ago, RSI14 > RSI14 two weeks ago, market cap >500; only OHLCV portion available without market cap; exact Chartink implementation requires fundamentals or explicit proxy exclusion.

promotion_requirements: Causal per-candle evaluation; no lookahead or incomplete higher-timeframe candles
Entry on next bar with gap-aware stops and stop-first same-bar resolution
Compare all candidates on same 1714-stock historical universe with fees/slippage
Report training/unseen count, net R, drawdown, stock breadth and market regime
Avoid selecting top strategies from unseen period then calling that period an unbiased test
Paper trading remains disabled until independent risk gate is tested
